access.quote: You can start for free: new accounts get 100 free credits, no card required, and one transcript costs one credit.
New accounts get 100 free credits with no card required.

mcp.quote: TranscriptAPI runs a hosted (remote) MCP server at `https://transcriptapi.com/mcp`.
Authentication: OAuth 2.1 (Claude, ChatGPT) or an API key sent as a Bearer token (OpenAI Agent Builder and other clients).

buildability.quote: After that, the paid plan is $5 a month for 1,000 credits per month, or $54 a year billed annually.

uncertain.access: 100 one-time free credits (no card) rather than a recurring free tier; a grader may read this as a trial. No stated expiry. Ongoing use needs the $5/mo plan; docs note free endpoints still need at least 1 active credit.
uncertain.auth_methods: REST API is API-key only. OAuth 2.1 exists only for the hosted MCP server (Claude/ChatGPT), so oauth2 was not listed for the public API.

notes: OpenAPI lists 13 GET operations (transcript, info, metadata, search, channel resolve/info/videos/playlists/posts/sections/search/latest, playlist videos) -> moderate. MCP exposes 12 tools. Vendor also publishes GitHub ZeroPointRepo/youtube-mcp (homepage transcriptapi.com) and an npm transcriptapi-mcp package. This is an unofficial third-party YouTube data service (not Google); YouTube ToS risk sits with the vendor, not the integrator. Unauthenticated GET https://transcriptapi.com/mcp returned an OAuth invalid_token 401, consistent with a live hosted server.
